notes.title: VERTICAL SLICE - NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
[p]Hi… um, hey dear followers! It’s been a while, hasn’t it? So… I have kind of exciting news! As promised before, I want to introduce you to the new version of… me. Welcome to the new [i]My Lust Wish[/i]![/p][p]
[img src="https://i.postimg.cc/SRyHQrTz/800px.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]This update is the beginning of a fresh start for me and [i]My Lust Wish.[/i] The team has been working hard, learning from all earlier versions of this game and other games. We’ve added new stuff — new mechanics, new systems — a lot is new. We know it might be a bigger change than some have expected, but I really believe this will make me a lot better and hotter and all I ask is you keep an open mind <3.[/p][p][/p][p]It’s not the finished game yet, but I am very proud to actually keep our promise to show a vertical slice and early development during August (and not even at the very last moment!) and hope you’ll like this version of me. We’re aiming to have the final release in about 6 to 10 months, but that’s still a pinky promise at the moment and not an “official” one. We will also post the development roadmap very soon after this.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]That being said, as you can see, the core systems of the game are there, working, and the development is actually going smoothly and well for once. We plan to keep it that way and we’ll keep you posted about the progress frequently.[/p][p][/p][p]The only thing we must admit we are not very happy with in this build are the animations and sequences/cinematics quality level as we are still missing a full-time animator and are looking for one (and if you are one please feel free to DM me! ;) ). But the animations quality does lack in the current build and will be improved a LOT in the future.[/p][p][/p][p]For now however, you can get a pretty good taste of how the game will look, feel, and play, even with limited content, some placeholders and just a small part of the content.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]I’d really love to hear what you think (but please be gentle.. this is my first time, after all ;) ), so please join the Discord and share your thoughts with me![/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for being here… and, um, stay kinky, okay?[/p][p]<3 Ashley[/p][p]
[img src="https://i.postimg.cc/cJPsJVwt/MLW-post.jpg"][/img]
[/p][p][i]Still missing from the Vertical Slice:[/i][/p][list][*][p]Save Game[/p][/*][*][p]Game Settings[/p][/*][*][p]Gawk-Gawk (blow-jobs) system[/p][/*][*][p]Edging Minigame[/p][/*][*][p]Facial Animations[/p][/*][*][p]Corruption System[/p][/*][*][p]Exhibitionism System[/p][/*][*][p]Environment NPCs will have something to say[/p][/*][*][p]More environmental NPCs, plus performance settings[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Sneak Peek Build!
notes.content:
Hey Everyone!

We are very happy to finally release the new test build we mentioned over the past weeks. [b]Please notice[/b] - [i]this build is a test build to show features we are working on but are still not ready for a full release as they're still in development and experimental[/i]. We are sharing this mostly, to be able to show and share our progress with you as well as get your feedback and thoughts about them!

This is the first test build and we are still just testing this idea so it has only the "Mirror of Desire" mode, as we mentioned a couple of weeks ago (Story mode is going through heavy reconstruction!👷). 

What is the Mirror of Desire? It is a sandbox version of the game where you can play all the sex scenes/positions/characters, fuck some NPC's and try different things! At the moment, it is completely unlocked, so you get to play with everything, but in the actual game you'll need to collect the poses, characters, scenes and such 

[b]Here is how to set up a beta branch: [/b]
[list]
[*] Go to your Steam library and find My Lust Wish
[*] Click with your right mouse button and choose properties
[img]https://i.imgur.com/iKmEIEC.png[/img]
[*] Choose Betas!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/u0Q6bnz.png[/img]

notes.title: Development Update
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone![/b]

If you have been following, you probably notices we had a slight delay with the development of the game, due to the problematic release of our other game "Slaves of Rome", which needed "all hands on deck" for the past month. However, we are happy to say that it seems things are a bit more stable now and that allows us to resume development of My Lust Wish while Rome is still being built and fixed by the rest of the team!

We already have a few big changes coming up in the next build:

[list]
[*] We are currently prototyping big changes to the sex system including a director mode that allows you to create and play your own scenes. In addition we are experimenting with a new minigame for climaxing, as well as different camera angles and controls.

[/list]

We will try to post sneak peaks for these updates very soon and hopefully post a build in about 6-8 weeks.
Stay kinky!

notes.title: WHAT'S NEXT
notes.content:
It's about time we released a new update on the project! We haven't really had much to say lately, due to a bunch of vacations lining up at around the same time, and everyone being busy working on making sure all the bugs that you've helped us find get squashed.

Lately our focus has been on re-evaluating the core experience of My Lust Wish. We want to create an erotic roleplaying game with an emphasis on Ashley's journey towards a more sexually liberated version of herself. And looking up on some of the mechanics we have planned out, we have come to the conclusion that if they are not pruned, we will be stuck making this game and putting out fires for the foreseeable future.

We don't want My Lust Wish to be a game stuck in a perpetual loop of Early Access like some titles on Steam. We want to finish the game, and we want it to be the very best it can possibly be, taking into account our team size and resources.

For this reason, we have decided to give up some of the more sim-like aspects of the game, as we feel they don't necessarily bring more value to the game, and are instead a hassle to manage. The biggest of these offenders are the various survival needs Ashley is saddled with, forcing the player to spend time taking care of things that we feel are not integral to our goals.

Another constant problem for us has been the game's world of Creamy Ridge. The original idea was to create an entire town to investigate and explore, but the truth of the matter is that performance issues and lack of content make the size we had in mind very problematic. Our attempts to fix it resulted in various other performance issues. In order to rectify this, we need to prune back the city considerably and make it more closed. This also solves the problem of traversal, which required considerable time from the player's part to get from one location to another.

Ashley's inventory has also been a problem. Having to play inventory Tetris in a game that's mainly focused around sexual content is counterproductive. Shuffling clothes, various foodstuffs, and quest items takes time off from the actually important things. For this reason we're reworking Ashley's inventory system to be a simpler affair, while still allowing for easy swapping of clothes.

One more important change is the addition of a sandbox mode, allowing the player easy access to the various scenes and poses.

notes.title: GAME UPDATE: Fixes and improvements!
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone! [/b]

We are happy to release a new update for My Lust Wish, after gathering all the feedback from the forums, comments, discord and more! This version should be a lot more stable which makes it a lot more fun. There are a LOT of life quality improvements here and we hope you like it! There are still some issues we are figuring out, mostly caused by the difference between patron and Steam and how those work. The only thing we are still figuring is the save system which gives us a lot of trouble, so we are sorry in advance about that, please bear with us as we are fixing that as well! Please let us know your thoughts - we hope (and think) this version should make a MUCH more smooth and enjoyable experience and can't wait to hear your thoughts as well!

[b]Change-log:[/b]

-Resolved the issue with the stutters/hitches. 
    The experience should now be considerably smoother.

-Waypoint system.
    Added waypoint system for the quests.
    Objectives for quests should now be easier to locate.

-UI improvements
    Sex UI has tooltips for its controls.
    Added exit to desktop button in the pause menu.
    Increased contrast and clarity of HUD text.
    Items in the inventory will correctly report their price.
    Added the option to skip the intro scene.
    Stat UI elements will flash when at critical level.
    Critical conditions will also be repeated via Ashley's monologue.

-Quests
    Fixed an issue in the quest logic that wouldn't allow them to update.
    (Quests affected: Do You Even Lift, AccessDenied, Sex In The City, Sexual Awakening)
    Added extra helper information via dialogue on the tutorial.
    Increased the amount of lust received from quests.

    Access Denied description and schedule fixes.
    Babes Illustrated, added missing titles and fixed bugs.
    Do You Even Lift and MorningWorkout, fixed an issue where they would activate simultaneously.
    Spellcasting For Beginners, fixed an issue where Teddie would give infinite colars. 
    Spellcasting quest, fixed misleading dialogues.
    Sex In The City, door in the rich hotel will properly unlock after you progress the quest.
    Sex in the City fixed an issue that was preventing completion.
    Sexual Awakening, fixed an issue with screen fading.
    Young Teacher, fixes an issue where the player would lose movement.
    Young Teacher, fixes an issue where the root of the dialogue was incorrectly active.
    Young Teacher, where the sequence would not stop.
    Young Teacher, fixed outdated directions. 
-Other fixes
    Fixed the issue where NPCs had their dicks out.
    Fixed some of the clipping issues related to Ashley's animations.
    Fixed an issue where Ashley couldn't get to Jenny's apartment.
    Stamina will regenerate faster.
    Post-process effects have been toned down when Ashley's needs are low.
    Fixed player getting stuck under surfaces after loading a save.
    Several fixes to the job system.
    Fixed various issues that caused sounds to cut off or not play.
    Fixed camera zooming when interacting.
    Fixed, incorrect sex transition animations.
    Buying objects from the bar increasing the money instead of reducing it
    Added missing shoes to Willie.
    Fixed Teddy's shoes texture.
    Fixed an issue where lust would stay frozen after orgasming.
    Disabled rain.
    Optimized levels and assets.

-Additions
    Cheat menu should be available after finishing the main story.
    Added experimental traffic and pedestrian system (this feature is experimental and will have a big performance impact, it comes disabled by default).

- Known Issues:

Saves following a version change will need to be cleared in ordered to avoid potential gameplay issues.
AccessDenied there is an issue where Jenny's dialogue will not unload after completing the quest. (This does not affect the progression of the game)

notes.title: HOTFIX: Major Release Bugs Fix
notes.content:
We received your feedback that the release seemed to have some serious bugs which we didn't notice - this was mostly caused by the difference in Versions between Patreon and Steam versions and how the saving systems works. We are sorry about that and hope this quick hotfix at least addresses the major issues, as we tried to do this as fast as possible. Of course, we will keep fixing more and more over the next days, weeks and months :). Here is a list of what should have been fixed in this update - would be happy to hear your feedback of course and if you encounter something major!


************************************************************************************
-Fixed an issue where the dialogue on the bus stop would not unload.
-Fixed an issue where some dialogue trigger boxes would load again after loading a saved game.
-Fixed an issue where the items inside a storage would be refreshed after loading a saved game.
-Fixed an issue where the saved games would get corrupted.
    It is highly recommended to clear old save game data.
-Improved the handling of saved games and their related files.
-Fixed an issue where the sequences where not unloading properly at the Janitor Job.
************************************************************************************

PLEASE NOTICE: IN ORDER TO WORK, YOU MIGHT NEED TO DELETE YOUR OLD SAVE (IF YOU HAVE AN OLD SAVE) FROM OLD (MOSTLY, NON-STEAM VERSIONS YOU MIGHT HAVE HAD BEFORE)
